incidentbot: AUTOMATED PAGE — inference-gateway-high-5xx-rate
incidentbot: Triggered at 2024-09-15T03:00:00Z (ts: 8743210000). 5m 5xx rate: 18% (threshold 5%). Affected region: eu-west1. PagerDuty: PD12345. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/5xx-gateway

pagerduty: PagerDuty Incident PD12345 created and routed to @sam_oncall. Auto-escalation in 5m.

sam (oncall): Acked in PD. I'm taking triage, pinging infra. Any deploys recently?

maria: No deploys to eu-west1 in last 60m. Tailing gateway logs now.

maria: ```
2024-09-15T02:59:12Z model-proxy error: upstream reset by peer id=model-srv-12
2024-09-15T02:59:15Z gateway 502 GET /v1/generate  count=22
2024-09-15T02:59:17Z gateway 502 POST /v1/chat  count=13
... (snip)
```

sam (oncall): Looks like model-proxy returning 502s and upstream resets. @ben can infra check model-serving pool health?

ben: I'm seeing connection resets and OOM kill events on model-proxy pods. Restarting a replica now (pod model-proxy-7f).

devops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl delete pod model-proxy-7f -n inference-eu` — pod restarted.

maria: Post-restart metrics: 5xx rate dropped to 9% over last 2m, latency improving. KV cache miss rate spiked earlier (cache_evictions: 1.2k/min).

sam (oncall): Good. Applying traffic weight shift to reduce load on eu-west1 for non-SLA customers.

routerbot: Traffic policy updated — eu-west1 weight decreased for non-sla routes. See: https://redwood.internal/console/routing/changes/8743210000

maria: Confirming customer impact: ~12k failed requests in last 10m, mostly non-SLA traffic. No escalations from customer support yet.

sam (oncall): We'll watch for 10m. If stable, we'll resolve PD and document follow-up (postmortem & possible memory-leak investigation). @ben keep an eye for reproducer.

ben: Will follow up in ticket INF-4523. Adding heap/profile logs to the ticket.

sam (oncall): Thanks — taking the lead on close. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 status: monitoring (acked). Auto-resolve timer paused by oncall.
